question: A spherical tank is filled with water. The radius of the sphere is 6 meters. The tank is used to fill cylindrical containers, each with a radius of 1 meter and a height of 12 meters. How many containers can be filled?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of containers = Volume of the Spherical Tank ÷ Volume of 1 Cylindrical Container

⇒ N = [(4/3) × π × R³] ÷ [π × r² × h]

⇒ N = [(4/3) × 6 × 6 × 6] ÷ [1 × 1 × 12]

⇒ N = 288 ÷ 12 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24 containers.**
